Holiday season brings an ordinary week
Bravo to the whole team
Smooth Moves for traveling pets

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways kept the pace steady as the holiday rush rolled on. The desk handled the usual stream of bookings, checks, and last-minute adjustments with a calm hand, while passengers got clear guidance before departure and pets moved through the process with less stress. The focus stayed on simple, direct support, so families could travel with confidence and the handoff between desk, gate, and cabin stayed clean.

Across the operation, the cabin team watched over animals in flight and passed along useful updates when needed, which helped the ground side keep records aligned and ready for the next turn. Small details still made the difference: tidy paperwork, firm follow-through, and quick answers at the counter. The result was a practical, well-run week that kept service moving and gave travelers a smoother path from check-in to arrival. The team can take pride in a shift handled with care and steady discipline.
